Lighting/mood: gentle golden afternoon, soft green gardens, warm brick and cream stone, dappled leaves and rich navy/teal shade. A grounded beautiful image of everyday civic care, belonging, and public services.
assets.visual_review: Inspected: coherent subject, strong upper/right light, quiet dark left, and no visible UI, logos, national flags, or legible text.
